components.note: 向 (toward) — a window 口 in a wall facing a direction, hence toward. It also gives its sound to 响 xiǎng and 饷 xiǎng.
礻 (altar, spirit — form of 示) — rites and blessings: 神, 礼, 祝, 祈; 福 is good fortune from the gods.
畐 (fú) sounds exactly like 福; also in 幅 fú, 副 fù, 富 fù.
车 (chariot) — war chariots drawn up in a circle (the top part shows the enclosure): an army camp, hence military.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 抱; 技 is hand skill.
支 (zhī) is a loose sound clue; same part in 枝 zhī and 肢 zhī.
口 (mouth) — eating and speech: 喝, 吸, 吗; 吃 is to eat.
乞 (qǐ) is only a loose sound clue for chī.
饣 (food, simplified 食) — meals and eating: 饿 hungry, 饱 full, 饺 dumpling; 饭 is cooked rice or a meal.
反 (fǎn) is a near sound match for fàn; also in 板 bǎn.
木 (tree) — a tree 木 boxed in by an enclosure 囗: trapped, hemmed in; hence 困难 difficulty.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings and mind: 怕, 情, 快; 忆 is remembering in the heart.
乙 (yǐ) stands in for 意 (yì) in the old form 憶, so it is a close sound clue for yì.
阝 (mound, left-side form of 阜 hill) — hills and places: 院, 阳, 陆; 队 is a group of people gathered together.
心 (heart) — feelings: 想, 思, 感, 怕; 急 is a heart in a hurry. The top is a variant of 及 (jí, reach), the same sound as in 级 and 极.
毛 (hair, fur) — hair and fine things: 毯 blanket, 尾 tail; 毫 is fine hair, then a tiny amount, as in 毫米 millimeter.
高 (gāo) is only a loose sound hint for háo.
酉 (wine jar) — fermented drinks: 酒, 醉 drunk, 酸 sour; 醒 is sobering up, then waking.
星 (xīng) sounds exactly like 醒 (tone differs).
旅 (travel) — a flag with people gathered under it: a troop on the march, then travellers on a journey.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings and mind: 怕, 情, 快; 惊 is a startled heart.
京 (jīng) sounds exactly like 惊; also in 鲸 jīng and 景 jǐng.
手 (hand) — the bottom form shows a hand; 拿 is two hands closing 合 on something: to take hold.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads: 过, 进, 送; 逮 is to chase and catch. 隶 shows a hand grabbing a tail.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 抱; 捕 is to seize.
甫 (fǔ) is a loose clue; also in 铺 pù, 辅 fǔ, 薄 báo.
方 (fāng) is a near sound match for páng (-ang); 方 also sounds out 房 fáng and 防 fáng.
氵 (water radical, 三点水) — water and liquids: 河, 海, 汤; 激 is water surging up, then to stir up.
敫 (jiǎo) is only a loose sound clue for jī.
马 (horse) — horses and riding: 骑 ride, 驾 drive, 驶; 骄 was a tall spirited horse, then proud.
乔 (qiáo) is a near sound match for jiāo; also in 桥 qiáo and 娇 jiāo.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 傲 is a proud person.
敖 (áo) is a near sound match for ào; also in 熬 áo.
木 (wood) — originally 權, the sliding weight of a steelyard scale: weighing, then power; 又 is just a simplification stand-in.
圣 (holy) — traditional 聖 had an ear 耳 and a mouth 口: the sage who listens and speaks wisely.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — speech: 说, 话, 请; 诞 first meant big talk, then birth and birthday.
延 (yán) is only a loose sound hint for dàn.
灬 (fire dots) — fire and heat: 热, 点, 煮, 照; 黑 is soot and smoke from a flame.
广 (building, shelter) — houses and shops: 床, 库, 座; 店 is a shop.
占 (zhàn) is a loose sound hint; same part in 站 zhàn and 战 zhàn.
冖 (cover, cloth) — things that cover: 写 write, 军, 冥; 冠 is a hand 寸 placing a cap 冖 on a head 元.
尚 (shàng) gives the -ang sound; also in 常 cháng, 偿 cháng, 堂 táng. The old form showed 旨 "tasty".
攵 (tap, hand with stick) — striking or acting: 教, 放, 政; 敌 is an opponent to strike.
舌 here is a form of 啇 (dí), the sound part; also in 滴 dī and 嫡 dí.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 抱; 搭 is to put up or join.
荅 (dā) sounds exactly like 搭; also in 答 dá.
木 (wood) — wooden things: 桌, 板, 架; 档 is a wooden shelf for files.
当 (dāng) is a near sound match for dàng; also in 挡 dǎng.
羽 (feather) — wings and feathers: 翅 wing, 翼, 习; 翰 was a feather pen, hence writing.
倝 (gàn) is a loose sound clue; same part in 韩 hán.
口 (mouth) — calling and speech: 吗, 喊, 呼; 叫 is to shout.
丩 (jiū) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 纠 jiū.
页 (head, page) — heads and faces: 头, 额 forehead, 题 title, 领 collar; 顺 is a head following the river 川 along.
川 (chuān) is only a loose sound hint; 训 xùn and 顺 shùn share it.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 傻 is a foolish person.
瓜 (melon) — a melon hanging from a vine. It lends its sound to 孤 gū and 狐 hú, besides 傻瓜 and 南瓜.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 推; 挑 is to pick out by hand.
兆 (zhào) is a loose sound clue; same part in 跳 tiào, 桃 táo and 逃 táo.
耳 (ear) — hearing and listening: 听, 闻, 聋; 职 is the duty one hears and remembers.
只 (zhī) is a near sound match for zhí; also in 织 zhī and 识 shí.
土 (earth) — ground and land: 地, 场, 块; 址 is a place on the ground.
止 (zhǐ) sounds exactly like 址.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 付 is handing 寸 something to a person.
付 (fù) is also the sound in 附 fù, 府 fǔ, 符 fú and 腐 fǔ.
礻 (altar, spirit — form of 示) — rites and prayer: 神, 福, 祝; 祈 is to pray.
斤 (jīn) is only a loose sound clue for qí.
礻 (altar, spirit — form of 示) — rites and prayer: 神, 福, 祈; 祷 is to pray aloud.
寿 (shòu) is only a loose sound clue; same part in 涛 tāo.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 抱; 拾 is to pick up. It is also a formal way to write ten.
合 (hé) is a loose sound hint.
犬 (dog) — animals: 狗, 猫; 状 first meant the shape of an animal.
丬 (a form of 爿) gives zhuàng: also in 壮 zhuàng, 装 zhuāng, 将 jiāng and 奖 jiǎng.
心 (heart) — feelings and attitudes: 想, 思, 感; 态 is one's attitude.
太 (tài) sounds exactly like 态.
囗 (enclosure) — boundaries: 国, 园, 图; 围 is to surround.
韦 (wéi) sounds exactly like 围; also in 违 wéi and 伟 wěi.
彳 (step, left foot) — walking and roads: 行, 往, 很, 得, 德; 彼 points out that, the other.
皮 (pí) is a loose sound clue; same part in 披 pī, 被 bèi, 破 pò.
